entries.title: Psalms 30:7
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Mountain - My kingdom: kingdoms are usually called mountains in prophetical writings.

entries.title: Psalms 30:9
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Profit - What wilt thou gain by it? The dust - Shall they that are dead celebrate thy goodness in the land of the living? Or, shall my dust praise thee?

entries.title: Psalms 30:11
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Sackcloth - Given me occasion to put off that sackcloth, which they used to wear in times of mourning, Esth 4:1 Psal 35:13 Isa 32:11 Joel 1:13 . Girded - With joy, as with a garment, surrounding me on every side.
